title: Hebrew calendar (months numbered from Tishri) with the 17th of Cheshvan circled
summary: A full Hebrew calendar of twelve months numbered 1 to 12 starting with Tishri, with Sukkot, Chanukkah, Pesach (Passover) and Shavuot marked. The 17th day of month 2 (Cheshvan) is circled in gold.

text.text: 1 Tishri (Sukkot 15–22) · 2 Cheshvan (17 circled) · 3 Kislev (Chanukkah 25–30) · 4 Tevet · 5 Sh’vat · 6 Adar · 7 Nisan (Pesach / Passover 14–22) · 8 Iyar · 9 Sivan (Shavuot 6–7) · 10 Tamuz · 11 Av · 12 Elul
